draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 121st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 8th of 20 at S. He went 99th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Juan Thornhill. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (2nd percentile), 10-yard split (8th percentile). College production: 59 tackles in 2023, 17th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 34 career games and 12 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 2 (76th percentile). Weak spots: passer rating allowed 111.8 (24th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 safety who played: 75.0% season snap share against a median of 41.8%, above the norm.
